question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Pacify
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Pacify"** means to calm someone down or bring peace to a situation. (शांत करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The mother tried to **pacify** her crying baby with a lullaby.
 
 
 
• **"Soothe" **refers to gently calming or relieving someone from stress or pain. (सांत्वना देना)
 
 
• **Example: **A warm bath can help to** soothe **sore muscles after a workout.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'pacify' **is **'soothe'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rebuke **(फटकार): Express sharp disapproval or criticism.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher **rebuked** the student for being late to class.
 
 
 
• **Blame **(दोष): Assign responsibility for a fault or wrong.
 
 
• **Example: **It’s unfair to** blame **her for the team's failure.
 
 
 
• **Strengthen** (मजबूत करना): Make something stronger or more effective.
 
 
• **Example:** Regular exercise can **strengthen** your immune system.
